note: Three independent concept flow boards. Concept only; no app implementation changed. Display order is authoritative.

concepts.name: Companion invitation
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality MOBILE APP UX concept image for Sobrita, an existing Spanish-language Android personal expense tracker with a cute pixel cat. This is a visual mockup, not an advertising poster or a real bank statement. Use the attached actual app screenshots as design-language references and the attached navy cat as the exact Michi character identity reference. Existing brand is Sobrita (older reference says Sobra; use Sobrita). Preserve navy ink #202848, warm off-white #FFFDF7, cream #F6EFE0, teal #0E7A72, soft teal #D8EDEA, small amber accents. Readable Pixelify Sans-like pixel headings and numbers, highly legible body text; dark square 2px borders with small hard offset shadows only for buttons, in the existing app style. Do not use rounded SaaS cards, glossy 3D characters, a new mascot, gradients, or a different color scheme.
Canvas: landscape 1800 x 1350. Show ONE coherent design direction as a THREE-STEP FLOW, three separate mobile app content frames side by side, each exactly the aspect ratio of 390 x 844, equally sized, no stretching. This is one concept across sequential states, not multiple alternative designs. Use generous margins with small descriptive labels above each frame: "LISTO PARA EMPEZAR", "PRIMER GASTO", "REGISTRO GUARDADO". Simple slim arrows in the gutters may connect the three frames. App content only: no phone bezels, rounded device masks, OS status bars, clock, notch, battery, browser UI or phone shadows. Modest heading above the board "Sobrita · Tu primer gasto". Do not show option numbers or explanatory paragraphs outside the screens.
Today is 2026-10-15 in Mexico City. Use "Hoy" rather than an obsolete date. Currency is MXN for this illustrative flow. Screen 1 has no invented saved transactions. Screen 2 shows the user has manually entered an illustrative 45 pesos, not an automatically saved sample. Screen 3 represents successful saving of that real example. Example daily allowance was MX$200, expense MX$45, remaining today MX$155. Make values consistent. Do NOT show XP totals or guaranteed financial outcomes.
Core experience: optional invitation to log one real expense after onboarding; user can skip. Then simple entry with visible amount/category/payment, optional details collapsed, then useful success with remaining amount and the same Michi character. Keep each frame focused on one clear primary action and at most two secondary actions. No feature inventory, shop, ads, upsells, streaks, reward currency, review requests, or cash-account setup. Use Spanish text exactly as specified.
Direction name for internal use only: Companion invitation.
Screen 1: a calm full-page onboarding completion. At top small Sobrita wordmark and small check with "Todo listo". A spacious cozy pixel room vignette with the exact Michi cat, similar to the room in the reference. Below, bold headline "¿Anotamos tu primer gasto?" and supporting copy "Si hoy gastaste algo, empecemos con uno." Bottom primary full-width teal button "Registrar mi primer gasto". Two smaller text choices below: "Aún no he gastado" and "Explorar Inicio". Respect 390px width and readable 14-16px body sizes.
Screen 2: a simple full-screen entry form. Header back arrow and "Tu primer gasto". Small sentence "Michi te acompaña." with a tiny Michi avatar. Amount label "¿Cuánto gastaste?" with large "$45" and small "MXN", visible text cursor. Under it two clearly labeled plain grouped rows: "Categoría" with selected "Comida", and "Pagaste con" with selected "Efectivo"; a lighter alternative "Tarjeta" can be shown beside Efectivo. Plain row "Fecha" / "Hoy". A collapsed "Añadir nota o recibo" disclosure. Primary teal "Guardar gasto". Below the form a clean three-column numeric keypad occupying the bottom quarter, digits 1 through 9 and 0, decimal and backspace. Keep the save button visible above the keypad; don't invent mandatory notes.
Screen 3: clean successful recording view with happy Michi and small teal check. Big headline "¡Tu primer gasto, listo!" Supporting text "Ya sabes a dónde fueron $45." A plain receipt-like row "Comida · Efectivo" and "$45 MXN". Below a prominent meaningful result, small label "Disponible para hoy" and big "$155 MXN". Primary button near bottom "Ver mi Inicio". Whitespace and very subtle pixel sparkles; warm restrained celebration.

Direction name for internal use only: Gentle home invitation.
This direction uses the HOME as the starting point and returns to the same home. Do not repeat the full-page onboarding illustration composition of the other concept.
Screen 1: new user's home, small Sobrita wordmark at top with settings icon, prominent "Hoy te queda" and "$200 MXN". A modest 140px-high pixel room with Michi, using the reference room, fits in the top third. Immediately below is ONE soft teal invitation area, labeled "Tu primer registro", headline "Un gasto, y empezamos." and short copy "Anota algo que hayas pagado hoy." Primary full-width teal button "Registrar un gasto". Small secondary text "Ahora no". A simple "Movimientos" heading below with the empty state "Tus gastos aparecerán aquí." Bottom navigation exactly the existing five destinations with selected Inicio: "Inicio", "Movim.", central plus icon, "Presup.", "Ajustes". This is a focused home with only the relevant invitation, not a crowded dashboard.
Screen 2: the same home dimmed behind an expanded bottom sheet with square pixel-styled top corners. The sheet begins just below the top quarter and occupies remaining height, showing header "Primer gasto" and a close icon. Entered "$45" with "MXN" large near top. Compact row "Comida" and "Efectivo" as selected clearly editable controls, then "Hoy" and collapsed "Nota o recibo". Teal "Guardar gasto" button. Below it a readable full numeric keyboard with three columns of digits 1-9 and bottom decimal, 0, backspace. Everything fits in the viewport. No phone OS chrome. This is an actual input sheet, not a modal permission popup.
Screen 3: same home and layout as screen 1. "Hoy te queda" now "$155 MXN". Same cozy room with Michi happily waving. Invitation is now replaced by a restrained success strip with check and "¡Primer gasto registrado!". Below "Movimientos" one simple row with a food icon, "Comida", subtitle "Hoy · Efectivo", and "-$45 MXN" aligned right. No duplicate expense rows. The home still has the same bottom navigation. This is an immediate visible before/after without an additional full-screen celebration.

Direction name for internal use only: One question with Michi.
Use a guided conversation with the companion, asking one small question at a time; distinct from a full-page welcome or a home dashboard. Do not make this into a generic chat app, no message composer, no avatars of humans, no multiple long text bubbles. Each mobile frame is a focused app page.
Screen 1: small Sobrita wordmark at top, a slim two-step progress indicator with text "Tu primer gasto · 1 de 2". Exact navy Michi sitting beside a small warm-cream speech panel, headline "¿Cuánto gastaste?" and small copy "Piensa en algo que hayas pagado hoy." One large empty amount field with gray "$0" placeholder and "MXN", not a saved expense. Supporting text "Puedes cambiarlo después." Primary outlined teal button "Continuar" to denote waiting for an amount, secondary "Aún no he gastado" clearly visible. Clean numeric keypad at the bottom with digits 1–9 and bottom decimal/0/backspace. Content is spacious; only the amount is being requested. No room illustration or home bottom tabs. The cat is a medium-sized friendly companion on the upper third, not an enormous decorative hero.
Screen 2: top back arrow and progress "Tu primer gasto · 2 de 2". Small compact amount summary "$45 MXN" with text link "Editar". Same Michi beside speech panel "¿En qué lo gastaste?". Three roomy category choices with small pixel icons: "Comida" selected teal, "Transporte", "Otro". Next short question "¿Cómo pagaste?" with two equally clear choices "Efectivo" selected and "Tarjeta". Small plain row "Fecha" / "Hoy". Optional collapsed disclosure "Añadir nota o recibo". Primary full-width teal button near bottom "Guardar mi gasto". No keypad on this second page. Plenty of space, no overly bordered nested cards. This is the user completing the category and payment for an amount they entered.
Screen 3: same Sobrita wordmark, minimal progress completed with check. Happy Michi holding a tiny receipt, speaking in one compact warm-cream panel: "¡Listo! Ya lo tenemos anotado." Large title "Tu primer registro". Plain grouped receipt: "Comida", "Efectivo · Hoy", "$45 MXN". Thin divider. Small label "Te quedan para hoy" and big "$155 MXN" in teal. Bottom primary button "Ir a Inicio". One quiet supporting line above the button: "Un gasto a la vez." No confetti wall, no XP, no money rewards or streak claims.
Keep all Spanish punctuation and exact text crisp and correctly spelled. No option numbers.
